basic_info.description: Buy It Now! Heavenly View Home With Cottage! Experience the first-class heavenly views from this hilltop family compound located in the desirable Noe Valley neighborhood. Perched high up on 29th Street, this home was re-envisioned in 2006 and became what it is today - a masterpiece of city living where your options are plentiful. The open floor plan on main level allows you to situate the rooms to your liking. The inviting front sitting area is a special place to relax and enjoy the incredible view. This great room atmosphere allows for TV/media room and dining area with built-in shelving. The adjacent kitchen at the back of the house is a centerpiece for conversation with large seating island & French doors opening to the huge back deck space with incredible views. You'll find three bedrooms on the upper level, two that share a front view balcony (one with en-suite full bath). The primary en-suite bedroom has show-stopping panoramic views with large deck. The lower level with street access can be your private guest suite, au pair quarters, family room/office/home gym. The separate, detached cottage with full bath is ready for your inspiration: private office, artist studio, game room. Close to J-Church, BART, & quick & easy access to freeways. Did I mention the views?
